# Jazz Night at the Lakeview Lounge

[Home](https://tahoe.example/) | [Events](https://tahoe.example/events) | [Accessibility Statement](https://tahoe.example/accessibility)

Friday, October 9 · 8:00 pm – 11:00 pm

Join the **Lakeview Trio** for an evening of standards in the lounge.

## Accessibility

The lounge is **wheelchair accessible**, with step-free entry from
the north parking lot. ASL interpretation is available on request — email
access@tahoe.example two weeks ahead.

All welcome! Bring a friend.
